A roomful of billionaires took up a collection to fund a blog that would make fun of college students, defend Israel, and patronize the sensibilities of not-very-bright but very rich boomers. One of those boomers then bought it for $150 million and also bought tiktok and much of the rest of the media. 

Good for you, but please spare us the parade.

I can't explain how surreal it is to see a @TheFP billboard in Times Square is given this all started at a kitchen table

Olivia Reingold (@Olivia_Reingold)

read it and weep legacy media!!

Community note: The Free Press, advertised on the billboard, was acquired by Paramount (owner of CBS News).

CBS News was founded in 1927, making them part of the "legacy media Big 3 TV Broadcasters", alongside NBC and ABC.

Bari Weiss, the FP founder, now runs CBS News.

If the Paramount-WB deal was a lock, these babies would not be pulling theirs ads from a substack over a columnist writing something against it.

Paramount is pulling its ads from @TheAnkler , I'm told. The decision seems to stem from columnist Richard Rushfield's opposition to the Paramount/WBD merger. Rushfield was one of the signatories on yesterday's  letter from 1k Hollywood players opposing the deal...
